A plant nursery classifies a perennial flower species as tall if its typical height when fully grown is more than 100 centimeters. Each of the following inequalities represents the possible heights h, in centimeters, for a specific perennial flower species when fully grown. Which inequality represents the possible heights h, in centimeters, for a tall perennial flower species?
questions.explanation: A tall species has every possible height above 100 centimeters, and only 107 < h < 158 meets that.

questions.question: In one week in 2017, a technician earned a total of $1,055 by working at her regular job and at a second job doing part-time work. The equation 20h + 17c = 1,055 represents this situation, where h is the number of hours worked at her regular job and c is the number of hours worked at her second job. Which of the following is the best interpretation of 20 in this context?
options: The amount, in dollars, the technician earned for each hour she worked at her regular job
The amount, in dollars, the technician earned for each hour she worked at her second job
The number of hours the technician worked in one week at her regular job
The number of hours the technician worked in one week at her second job
questions.explanation: 20 multiplies h, the hours at the regular job, so it is the dollars earned per regular-job hour.

questions.question: The graph of the linear equation 4x + By = 12 is shown, where B is a constant. What is the value of B?
questions.explanation: The line passes through (0, 2). Substituting: 4(0) + B(2) = 12, so B = 6.

questions.question: The population of a certain city doubled every 75 years from 1658 to 1958. The population of this city was 160,000 in 1958. What was the population of this city in 1658?
questions.explanation: From 1658 to 1958 is 300 years, or 4 doublings, so the 1658 population was 160,000 ÷ 2^4 = 10,000.

questions.question: Which expression is equivalent to 13(x<sup>2</sup> − 7)?
questions.explanation: Distribute 13: 13x^2 − 91.

questions.question:
3x + 2y = 10
18x + 12y = 60
How many solutions does the given system of equations have?
questions.explanation: The second equation is 6 times the first, so the equations describe the same line and there are infinitely many solutions.

questions.question: The town of Fillmore is planning its annual fireworks show. The equation y = −16(x − 6.8)<sup>2</sup> + 740 gives the estimated height y, in feet, of a type of firework x seconds after it is launched into the air. Which of the following is the best interpretation of the vertex of the graph of the equation in the xy-plane?
options: This type of firework reaches an estimated maximum height of 740 feet 16 seconds after it is launched into the air.
This type of firework reaches an estimated maximum height of 740 feet 6.8 seconds after it is launched into the air.
This type of firework reaches an estimated maximum height of 16 feet 740 seconds after it is launched into the air.
This type of firework reaches an estimated maximum height of 6.8 feet 740 seconds after it is launched into the air.
questions.explanation: The vertex is (6.8, 740), and the parabola opens downward, so it is a maximum.

kx2 − 16x = 27x2 − 8
In the given equation, k is an integer constant. If the equation has two distinct real solutions, what is the greatest possible value of k?
questions.explanation: Rewrite as (k − 27)x^2 − 16x + 8 = 0. Two distinct real solutions need discriminant 256 − 32(k − 27) > 0, so k < 35. The greatest integer is 34.

The population of City A increased by 9% from 2015 to 2016. If the 2016 population is k times the 2015 population, what is the value of k?
questions.explanation: A 9% increase multiplies the population by 1.09.

questions.question: A gallery had x artifacts in a collection. When more artifacts were added to the collection, number of artifacts increased by 149%. What is the number of artifacts in the collection in terms of x?

A group of 40 employees selected at random from all the employees at a company were surveyed about the number of books they read last year. From the data collected, it was estimated that the mean number of books employees at the company read last year is 6.8, with an associated margin of error of 1.1. Which of the following is the most appropriate conclusion?
options: It is plausible that the actual mean number of books employees at the company read last year is less than 5.7.
It is plausible that the actual mean number of books employees at the company read last year is between 5.7 and 7.9.
It is plausible that every employee at the company read between 6.8 and 10.1 books last year.
It is plausible that the actual mean number of books employees at the company read last year is greater than 7.9.
questions.explanation: 6.8 ± 1.1 gives plausible means from 5.7 to 7.9.

questions.question: For a certain rectangular region, the ratio of its length to its width is 10 to 4. If the width of the rectangular region increases by 7 units, how must the length change to maintain this ratio?
questions.explanation: The length is 10/4 = 2.5 times the width, so a 7-unit increase in width needs a 2.5(7) = 17.5-unit increase in length.

In triangle QRS shown, QR < RS. Which expression represents the length of QS?
questions.explanation: Side RS = 37 is opposite angle Q and QS is the hypotenuse, so sin Q = 37/QS, giving QS = 37/sin Q.

questions.question: The width of a rectangle is 16 inches less than 2 times its length, in inches. The area of the rectangle is 130 square inches. What is the width, in inches, of the rectangle?
questions.explanation: With length L, L(2L − 16) = 130 gives L^2 − 8L − 65 = 0, so L = 13 and the width is 2(13) − 16 = 10.

questions.question: The perimeter of an isosceles right triangle is 52 + 52√2 inches. What is the length, in inches, of the hypotenuse of this triangle?
questions.explanation: With legs a and hypotenuse a√2, a(2 + √2) = 52(1 + √2), so a = 52/√2 = 26√2 and the hypotenuse is 26√2 · √2 = 52.

questions.question: A right square pyramid has a height of 6 units and a volume of 128 cubic units. What is the length, in units, of one side of the base of the pyramid?
questions.explanation: V = (1/3)s²h gives 128 = (1/3)s²(6) = 2s², so s² = 64 and s = 8.

questions.question: In one week in 2017, a technician earned a total of $700 by working at her regular job and at a second job doing part-time work. The equation 16h + 13c = 700 represents this situation, where h is the number of hours worked at her regular job and c is the number of hours worked at her second job. Which of the following is the best interpretation of 16 in this context?
options: The amount, in dollars, the technician earned for each hour she worked at her regular job
The amount, in dollars, the technician earned for each hour she worked at her second job
The number of hours the technician worked in one week at her regular job
The number of hours the technician worked in one week at her second job
questions.explanation: The term 16h is the earnings from the regular job, and h is hours, so 16 is dollars earned per hour at the regular job.

questions.question: The cost to rent a bus from Company X is $950 for the first 2 hours and an additional $50 per hour for each hour after the first 2 hours. If the total cost to rent the bus from Company X for t hours, where t > 2 is $1,250, which equation represents this situation?
The graph of 9x + y = 16 in the xy−plane is a line. What is the slope of the line?
questions.explanation: Rewrite as y = −9x + 16; the slope is −9.

questions.question: If x + 3y = 29 and 7x − 12y = −61, what is the value of y?
questions.explanation: From the first equation x = 29 − 3y. Substituting: 7(29 − 3y) − 12y = −61, so 203 − 33y = −61 and y = 8.

questions.question: A company that manufactures staplers calculates its monthly profit, in dollars, by subtracting its fixed monthly costs, in dollars, from its monthly sales revenue, in dollars. The equation 11,000 = 2.00x − 6,500 represents this situation for a month where x staplers are manufactured and sold. Which statement is the best interpretation of 2.00x in this context?
options: The monthly sales revenue, in dollars, from selling x staplers
The monthly sales revenue, in dollars, from each stapler sold
The monthly cost, in dollars, of manufacturing each stapler
The monthly cost, in dollars, of manufacturing x staplers
questions.explanation: Profit equals revenue minus fixed costs, so 2.00x is the revenue from selling x staplers.

options: The company's estimated stock price increased $70 every day after the company went public.
The company's estimated stock price increased $1 every 70 days after the company went public.
1 day after the company went public, the company's estimated stock price is $70.
70 days after the company went public, the company's estimated stock price is $1.

questions.explanation: c^6 = 9c^4 gives c^2 = 9, so c = 3.

questions.question: The function f is defined by f(x) = a^x + b, where a and b are constants and a > 0. In the xy−plane, the graph of y = f(x) has a y−intercept at (0, −22) and passes through the point (2, 41). What is the value of a + b?
questions.explanation: f(0) = 1 + b = −22 gives b = −23. Then f(2) = a² − 23 = 41 gives a² = 64, so a = 8 (a > 0), and a + b = −15.

A certain investment account offers a special interest rate for the first 4 months the account is open followed by a lower interest rate for the remainder of the time the account is open. Bennett opened one of these accounts with an original account balance of $900 and did not make any other deposits or withdrawals. 4 months after Bennett opened the account, the balance had increased by 0.6% of the original balance. 6 months after Bennett opened the account, the balance had increased by an additional 0.1% of the balance at the end of the first 4 months. Every 2 months after the first 6 months, the balance had increased by an additional 0.1% of the balance 2 months before. Which of the following equations could represent the account balance B(x), in dollars, x months after the account was opened, where x ≥ 4?
questions.explanation: After 4 months the balance is 900(1.006) = 905.40. It then grows by a factor of 1.001 every 2 months, which is (x − 4)/2 = x/2 − 4/2 periods after month 4.

questions.question: The function f is defined by f(x) = (x − 10)(x − 8)(x − 4). In the xy-plane, the graph of y = g(x) is the result of translating the graph of y = f(x) up 6 units. What is the value of g(0)?
A cylinder has a diameter of 6 inches and a height of 24 inches. What is the volume, in cubic inches, of the cylinder?
questions.explanation: The radius is 3, so V = π(3²)(24) = 216π.

questions.question: A partially filled container containing 24 milliliters of water is placed under a leaky faucet that produces one 0.03-milliliter drop of water every 3 seconds. Until the container is full, which of the following can be used to represent the volume v, in milliliters, of water in the container t seconds after it is placed under the faucet, where t is a multiple of 3?
questions.explanation: The rate is 0.03/3 = 0.01 milliliters per second.
